target_moa.text: Lubiprostone is a locally acting chloride channel activator that specifically activates ClC-2 on the apical membrane of the human intestine, enhancing chloride-rich intestinal fluid secretion and thereby increasing intestinal motility.

citations.quote: Lubiprostone is a locally acting chloride channel activator that enhances a chloride-rich intestinal fluid secretion without altering sodium and potassium concentrations in the serum.
Lubiprostone acts by specifically activating CIC-2, which is a normal constituent of the apical membrane of the human intestine, in a protein kinase A-independent fashion.

By increasing intestinal fluid secretion, lubiprostone increases motility in the intestine, thereby increasing the passage of stool and alleviating symptoms associated with chronic idiopathic constipation.
Lubiprostone (RU-0211) is a prostaglandin E_1 metabolite analogue and is formulated in a soft gelatin capsule with liquid contents of lubiprostone and a medium-chain fatty acid triglyceride.

key_safety.text: Across all active doses (N=1175) the most common adverse events were nausea (30.9% vs 5.1% placebo), diarrhea (13.2% vs 0.9%), headache (13.0% vs 6.6%), abdominal distension (6.8% vs 2.8%), abdominal pain (6.8% vs 2.2%), and flatulence (5.9% vs 1.9%); serious adverse events were low (2.9% RU-0211 vs 1.3% placebo).

citations.quote: Across all active doses of lubiprostone (N=1175) in the well-controlled group and the long-term safety group studies, the most commonly reported adverse event preferred terms were nausea (30.9%), diarrhea (13.2%), headache (13.0%), abdominal distension (6.8%), abdominal pain (6.8%), and flatulence (5.9%). Comparatively for placebo (N=316), the corresponding reports of adverse events in the above preferred terms were; nausea (5.1%), diarrhea (0.9%), headache (6.6%), abdominal distension (2.8%), abdominal pain (2.2%), and flatulence (1.9%). Besides headache, the most commonly reported adverse events in the active drug group were gastrointestinal in nature, which may be representative of the pharmacodynamic effects of lubiprostone.
The occurrence of serious adverse events in the studied population was relatively low (1.3% in the placebo group and 2.9% in the RU-0211 48 mcg group).
